info.bio:
Cake es una banda de Sacramento, California, formada en 1991. Ha tenido varios éxitos a lo largo de los 1990’s y 2000’s con sus cinco discos.

A pesar de que la música de Cake es regularmente clasificada como rock alternativo o indie rock, combina múltiples géneros musicales, tales como funk, ska, pop, jazz, rap, y country. Su música incluye letras curiosas con abundantes juegos de palabras y síncopa, pegajosos riffs de guitarra distorsionada y solos de trompeta.

scenes.name: Alt-country
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: La revolución iniciada en Chicago por Souled American y Uncle Tupelo (No Depression: baladas country con la furia del hardcore) se convierte en los noventa en un género propio: sus herederos abandonan el hardcore por los sonidos más espartanos y tradicionales. Son Volt de Jay Farrar y Wilco de Jeff Tweedy (Being There, Yankee Hotel Foxtrot); Will Oldham (Palace) arranca el movimiento; Freakwater, Ida, Handsome Family, Retsin, Blue Mountain, Whiskeytown, Grant Lee Buffalo, Citizens' Utilities, Willard Grant Conspiracy. El «chamber folk» de Lambchop, Lullaby For The Working Class, Geraldine Fibbers y Pinetop Seven; el country-rock de Volebeats, Ass Ponys, Sixteen Horsepower, Old 97's y los terroristas Grifters; el folk-rock de Swell, Counting Crows, Cracker, Cake, Hootie & The Blowfish; los Black Crowes; Belle And Sebastian, Arab Strap y los polacos Atman.

podcast.title: Band's Disassociation
podcast.body: The other members of Cake explicitly stated that they wish they had never met Pete McNeill and should not be blamed for his actions, underscoring their horror and devastation regarding his crimes. "Do not blame the band for anything he did. They wish they'd never met the guy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Child Sex Abuse Charges and Conviction
podcast.body: Pete McNeill, who was once the drummer for Cake, was charged with child sex abuse in 2012 for attempting to molest a six-year-old girl while volunteering at a school in Los Angeles, which resulted in a mistrial. Earlier, in 2009, he was accused of molesting a three-year-old girl at a Thanksgiving celebration. This earlier case also led to a mistrial, but at the retrial, he was found guilty and is now serving a 15-year prison term, classified as a sex offender for life. "In 2012, he was charged with child sex abuse after trying to molest a six-year-old girl while working as a volunteer at a school in Los Angeles."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Potential "Bent Band" Inclusion
podcast.body: Cake was suggested as a band that "might" be included on a list of "bent" or unconventional artists. "We might include cake on this list."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Studio Recordings and Live Performances
podcast.body: Pete McNeill never appeared on any of Cake's studio recordings. However, he performed live with the band many times, playing numerous songs during these performances. "He never appeared on any of their studio recordings, but he did play this song with the band live many, many times."
